desc: Set an existing regular user or owner to be a workspace or org admin.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

team_id.desc: The ID of the workspace or organization.

user_id.desc: The ID of the user to designate as an admin.

cannot_modify_primary_owner.desc: The primary owner cannot be modified.

failed_to_set_user_to_admin.desc: Designating this user as an admin failed.

failed_to_set_admin_on_workspaces.desc: Failed to set the user as an admin on all workspaces.

feature_not_enabled.desc: The Admin APIs feature is not enabled for this team.

invalid_permissions.desc: This method is only accessible by org owners and admins.

invalid_role_for_user.desc: The user cannot be made into an admin.

not_an_admin.desc: This method can only be accessed by org owners and admins.
